data.name: Cardinal Ethanol
data.description: Cardinal Ethanol is an Indiana-based corn ethanol producer (roughly 135-140 million gallons per year) that, through the 50/50 One Carbon Partnership joint venture with Vault 44.01, is developing a BECCS project to capture and permanently sequester biogenic fermentation CO2 at its Union City, Indiana plant. In April 2026 the EPA Region 5 issued a final Class VI UIC permit authorizing injection of up to 450,000 metric tons of CO2 per year (about 13.5 million tonnes over 30 years). Ethanol production — not CDR — is Cardinal's core business; the CCS project is an adjacent decarbonization add-on driven by 45Q, 45Z and low-carbon-fuel economics.
